title: I10 GEMINI POINTLOCK engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

angle_rate.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

items.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

plant_parameters.x-encoding: posterior record: representation is explicit; weights and sample dimensions require domain validation.
plant_parameters.x-unit: kg m^2, N m s rad^-1, s

wheel_state.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

electrical_ledger.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
electrical_ledger.x-quality-rule: Current sign and power calibration; no mechanical-energy substitution.

mechanical_energy.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
